title: sharpness detail and tonemapping controls

commit.merge_subject: merge: sharpness detail and tonemapping controls

description:
Package 3, part 2 (COL-15/COL-16): carry the three new grade fields
from the editor UI down through every pipeline entry point, on both
clip kinds.

Engine:
- GradeK gains sharpness/detail (float, neutral 0) and tonemap
  (int, 0=off/1=ACES/2=AgX); GradeStore renders and parses them with
  neutral fallbacks, so pre-COL-15/16 project.json files load with the
  exact old look (binding requirement).
- ExportStore snapshots carry the same three fields with the same
  neutral fallbacks for old export queues.
- JNI bridge: all four entry points (preview render, cached render,
  export frame, encoded develop) take the three values as flat params
  after keepVignetting, in rawedit::Grade field order; gradeFromKotlin
  maps them onto the native Grade.
- NativeSource externals + wrappers, PreviewRenderer GradeMapping,
  PreviewSession and Mp4Exporter pass them through; developEncoded
  consumes th
